entities.summary: Moushumi Kandali is a writer, historian and translator from Assam, India. Kandali won the Munin Barkataki Award in 2000 for her first collection of short stories, Lambada Nachor Seshot, which was published in 1998. She is a researcher and writer of fiction as well as art. She works as an assistant professor in the Department of Cultural Studies in Tezpur University, Assam.
